scholarships.title: Programa RESTART — 4ª Edição (FCT research funding after parental leave)
scholarships.official_source: Fundação para a Ciência e a Tecnologia (FCT), I.P.

existing.funding_period: per project, up to 18 months of project development
existing.description: RESTART is an FCT funding instrument that competitively finances individual R&D projects in all scientific domains for researchers who have recently taken a parental leave, including adoption leave. The award is a project grant of up to EUR 50,000 per project for a maximum of 18 months, drawn from a total budget allocation of EUR 1.6 million, and it is held by the beneficiary R&D unit rather than paid as a personal living stipend. Candidates must hold a doctorate, be an integrated doctoral member of an R&D unit or hold a contract with a State laboratory, and have taken a parental leave of at least 120 days (or at least 72 days in a shared leave, whether exclusive or shared) between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 inclusive.
eligibility: Hold a doctorate degree (ser detentor do grau de doutor)
Be an integrated doctoral member of an R&D unit, or hold a contractual link with a State laboratory

Have benefited from a parental leave, including for adoption, of a duration equal to or greater than 120 days between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 inclusive; in the case of a shared parental leave, including for adoption, the candidate must demonstrate having taken, exclusively or shared, at least 72 days of leave
The minimum number of days required (120 or 72) must be reached between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 inclusive, regardless of the start or end date of the leave
Applications must be submitted with the commitment of the host institution

Researchers holding a scholarship contract may submit as proof of parental leave the statement of suspension of research activities funded by that scholarship, issued by the contracting institution, for an equivalent period; for FCT scholarships this may be replaced by simply indicating the relevant scholarship reference
Eligible applicants are national, foreign and stateless researchers
existing.eligibility_summary: Researchers (national, foreign or stateless) who hold a doctorate, belong to an R&D unit or hold a State laboratory contract, and have taken a parental leave of at least 120 days (or 72 days for shared leave) between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 inclusive, with a host institution commitment.
benefits: Total budget allocation of EUR 1.6 million for the programme
Gender and opportunity equality objective of the programme
Alignment with European Council and OECD recommendations on reconciling professional and family life for those working in R&D
coverage: Competitive funding of individual R&D projects in all scientific domains
Project duration of up to 18 months
Maximum funding of EUR 50,000 per project
Possibility of associating other human and/or material resources, according to the funding made available and the planned execution time
requirements: Applications must be submitted by filling in a dedicated form, in English, accessible electronically on myFCT
Applications open 01 October 2026 at 14h and close 13 November 2026 at 17h
The application must be filed with the commitment of the host institution
Researchers who are beneficiaries of FCT-funded or FCT-recommended projects as PI (IR) or Co-PI (Co-IR) as of 01 September 2026 are not eligible
Applications previously selected for funding by FCT or other funding agencies are not admitted

Multiple applications sharing all or part of the work plan are not admitted, either within this notice or in different notices with overlapping application periods; in the case of multiple applications to different thematic notices with different application periods, a funding recommendation in one is a condition for exclusion from the others
documents: Application form completed in English on myFCT

Proof of parental leave, or for scholarship holders the statement of suspension of research activities issued by the contracting institution; for FCT scholarships, the scholarship reference instead of the statement
existing.english_requirement: The proposals must be sent by filling in a dedicated form, in English (As propostas devem ser enviadas através do preenchimento, em língua inglesa, de um formulário próprio que poderá ser acedido eletronicamente no myFCT).
application_method: Confirm you meet all three cumulative eligibility requirements at the deadline for the application submission period
Obtain the commitment of the host institution
Check you are not an IR or Co-IR of an FCT-funded or FCT-recommended project as of 01 September 2026, and that you have no other funding selection
Prepare proof of the qualifying parental leave, or the equivalent statement of suspension for scholarship holders
Complete the dedicated form in English on myFCT
Submit during the published application period (01 October 2026 14h to 13 November 2026 17h)
existing.selection_notes: The RESTART programme's evaluation criteria are: i) scientific quality, innovative character and feasibility of the proposed research plan; ii) merit of the candidate and fit of their profile with the research plan; and iii) impact of the project's execution on the development of the researcher's career.
existing.best_fit: Doctorate-holding researchers, including foreign and stateless researchers, based at a Portuguese FCT-funded R&D unit or State laboratory, who have taken a qualifying parental or adoption leave between 3 June 2025 and 1 October 2026 and can obtain a commitment from their host institution.
existing.notes: Not a tuition, living-cost or personal stipend award: the funding is a project grant to the beneficiary R&D unit. Beneficiary entities are R&D units funded by FCT's Multi-Year Funding Programme, State laboratories, and laboratories associated with a recognised status; where a host institution has no legal personality, the beneficiary entity is the legally constituted institution in which it is integrated. Multiple simultaneous applications are prohibited where work plans overlap in whole or in part, and a funding recommendation in one overlapping application excludes the others from the decision process. Candidates with doubts about the parental-leave day count are invited to contact restart@fct.pt and may request telephone or videoconference support from an FCT team member.
existing.application_period: 01 October 2026 (14h) to 13 November 2026 (17h). The 2026 FCT contest calendar lists the opening notice for October 2026, provisional results in April 2027, and the programme page shows 'Atualizado em 1 Outubro 2026'.
existing.deadline_display: Applications open 01 October 2026 at 14h and close 13 November 2026 at 17h (Portuguese time)
